failure_class: A partial success / Model economic-value failure
summary: V13 improved statistical discrimination (Val AUC 0.72 vs V12 0.50) by using a 2s horizon + order-flow persistence features. However, gross EV remained ~0 (-0.16 bps), so the signal ranks returns correctly but has NO economic value after costs (-5.92 bps net).
dominant_mechanism: Statistical-discrimination ≠ economic-value. The V13 model achieves AUC 0.72 on held-out calibration data, but predicted return magnitudes (binned calibration) are near-zero. Even when the model correctly ranks a trade as favorable, the expected return magnitude (~0 bps) is far below the 14.52 bps execution-cost barrier. The 2s holding period is too short for order-flow persistence to generate enough edge to overcome Binance taker fees + slippage.
eliminated_alternatives: NOT overfitting: train AUC (0.715) ≈ val AUC (0.720); gap is modest
NOT a data integrity issue: forward data is temporally separated from calibration
NOT a leakage issue: chronological split, no future features
NOT an execution-cost inflation: 14.52 bps matches Binance fees + realistic slippage
can_be_corrected_without_oos_contaminati: NO — forward result reflects genuine lack of economic value. Requires V14 with new hypothesis.
